arjun: Heads-up: finance + legal approved a targeted change to our overage handling for hosted API customers. Rolling out next billing period (starts 2026-07-01).

arjun: Summary: introduce a 72-hour overage buffer on new accounts and a single-step automated waiver for invoices < $75. The goal is to reduce churn from accidental spikes and speed dispute resolution.

lisa: Quick q: does this mean we won't bill overages for 72 hours? Or we bill and then waive?

arjun: We will still meter usage normally. For accounts created within the last 30 days, the first overage in any calendar month will be flagged and held for 72 hours before finalizing the invoice charge. If usage subsides within that window, finance will auto-apply a one-time waiver up to $75. For established accounts (older than 30 days) we'll still allow a one-time waiver but it requires a manual review if > $75.

matt: How does this interact with rate limits? We don't want customers to rely on the buffer to abuse quotas.

arjun: Important: this is purely billing-side. Rate limits and throttles remain enforced in real time. The buffer does NOT change token caps or per-minute quotas. Abuse teams will still get alerts for sustained over-limit behavior.

billing-bot: Sample behavior log entry: 
```
account: acct_12345 (created 2026-06-20)
overage detected: 2026-07-03T14:05Z -> flagged for 72h hold
finalization window: 2026-07-06T14:05Z
auto-waiver eligible: yes (amount $28.40)
```

legal: We added language to TOS and billing terms: "Temporary billing holds and nominal waiver limits are intended to reduce accidental overage harm and are not an entitlement to sustained unpaid usage." Please don't promise unlimited free windows to customers.

customer-success: We'll draft a short outbound note for trial customers and add a line to the onboarding checklist. Also adding a support macro: "If your team is within their first 30 days, small accidental overages may be held for 72 hours and automatically waived if under $75. For billing questions contact billing@redwood.ai."

lisa: Any dashboard changes? Ops want to see which accounts are in a hold window.

arjun: Yes, finance is adding a "billing hold" flag to the account view and a list in the billing UI that shows pending holds and waiver eligibility. Ops also gets a read-only list for monitoring.

matt: Are resellers / consolidated billing impacted?

arjun: For reseller/partner invoicing the policy is opt-in only. We'll surface the option in partner settings; partners must explicitly enable buffer on their customers.

customer-success: Sending an email template to AEs now. Will tile the change in the weekly product bulletin.

arjun: Thanks. If anyone finds edge cases (prepaid credits, multi-tenant orgs, or government contracts) add them to the tracker and @me.
